title: Implement Phase 1 (Foundation & Architecture) for OnlySigned

requirements.text: Backend: Ensure Phase 1 foundation endpoints are implemented and usable from the frontend, specifically: access control bootstrap (initializeAccessControl), authentication-gated profile read/write (getCallerUserProfile, saveCallerUserProfile), admin recovery (reclaimAdminAccess), and role/admin checks (getCallerUserRole, isCallerAdmin, isCallerApproved). These methods must compile and be callable via the generated frontend actor bindings.
acceptanceCriteria: `dfx build` succeeds for the backend canister.
Candid exposes callable methods for: initializeAccessControl, getCallerUserProfile, saveCallerUserProfile, reclaimAdminAccess, getCallerUserRole, isCallerAdmin, isCallerApproved.
Calling getCallerUserProfile without a user role results in a clear rejection (trap) consistent with backend authorization rules.
saveCallerUserProfile assigns a stable `userNumber` for the caller and sets `isAdmin` for the first user as currently coded.

requirements.text: Frontend: Replace the current single-page HomePage-only rendering with an application shell that includes a reusable Layout, Header (top navigation), and Footer components, and add navigation to the main sections (Home, Profile, Assets, Collections, Marketplace, Messages, Admin). Admin navigation must only be visible when the logged-in user is an admin.
acceptanceCriteria: The app renders a consistent header/footer on all pages.
Navigation links switch between pages without a full page reload (client-side navigation).
The Admin link is hidden for non-admin users and visible for admin users.
The previously empty component files `frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx`, `Header.tsx`, and `Footer.tsx` are implemented (without modifying any immutablePaths).

requirements.text: Frontend: Implement Phase 1 page scaffolding for the existing placeholder routes/pages (AdminDashboardPage, AssetDetailPage, CertificateValidationPage, CollectionDetailPage, CollectionsPage, ContactsPage, ContactInvitationsPage, MarketplacePage, MessagesPage, MyCollectiblesPage, MyCollectionPage, PitchDeckPage, PrivacyPolicyPage, ProfilePage, PublicProfilePage, SupportPage, UploadPage, UserExplorerPage, UsernameNFTsPage, WellKnownPage). Each page must render a clear title, a short description, and a consistent “Coming in Phase X” placeholder where applicable, while keeping the app functional and navigable.
acceptanceCriteria: All listed placeholder page modules render non-empty UI (no blank screens).
Navigating to each page shows a title and description in English.
No runtime errors occur when visiting any page while logged out or logged in.

requirements.text: Frontend: Update the Home page experience to match Phase 1 “Foundation” (not “backend incomplete”). Keep Internet Identity login/logout and profile creation/editing, but remove the destructive alert that says the backend is incomplete. Add an onboarding-friendly status panel that shows: login status, principal (when logged in), profile status (exists/doesn’t exist), and admin status (if applicable).
acceptanceCriteria: Home page no longer displays the destructive alert text: “Backend Implementation Required”.
When logged out, the Home page shows a clear login call-to-action.
When logged in, the Home page shows the principal string and whether a profile exists.
When a profile exists, the UI indicates whether the user is admin based on returned profile data.
Profile create/update continues to work using existing React Query hooks (`useGetCallerUserProfile`, `useSaveCallerUserProfile`).

requirements.text: Frontend: Establish a coherent, distinctive visual theme applied across the app shell and Phase 1 pages (colors, typography, spacing, surface styles) using the existing Tailwind/OKLCH token approach. Do not use a blue/purple primary palette.
acceptanceCriteria: App has a consistent, intentional look across header, footer, and pages (not default/unstyled).
Primary actions, cards, and navigation states have consistent styling.
The chosen theme does not rely on blue/purple as the primary brand colors.

requirements.text: Frontend: Add the generated brand images as static assets under `frontend/public/assets/generated/` and render them in the app shell (logo in header; favicon at minimum configured for the app). Do not serve these images from the backend.
acceptanceCriteria: Files exist under `frontend/public/assets/generated/` matching the imageRequirements filenames.
Header displays the logo image asset.
The app includes a favicon referencing the generated favicon asset.

constraints: Backend must remain a single Motoko actor in `backend/main.mo` (no additional backend services).

Do not modify any frontend immutable paths: `frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts`, `frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx`, `frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts`, `frontend/src/main.tsx`, `frontend/src/components/ui`.
Use English for all user-facing text.
Do not route generated images through the backend; serve them as static frontend assets.
nonGoals: Implementing Phase 2+ features (subscriptions, messaging logic, NFT minting/ICRC-7, marketplace transactions, admin moderation workflows, etc.) beyond basic scaffolding and navigation.
Restoring/rolling back production builds to “Version 60 exactly” (requires external artifacts outside this build request).
Third-party authentication providers (only Internet Identity is in scope).

required: OnlySigned wordmark logo, minimalist, high-contrast, transparent background (onlysigned-logo.dim_512x128.png)
OnlySigned icon mark (simple monogram), transparent background (onlysigned-icon.dim_256x256.png)
Favicon icon, simplified mark, transparent background (favicon-onlysigned.dim_64x64.png)
